item.title: SPIDER-MAN: BRAND NEW DAY Rumored To Make This Huge Change To Mark Ruffalo's Savage Hulk - SPOILERS
item.description: Rumoured new Spider-Man: Brand New Day details shed light on plans for The Hulk when he goes "Savage," and it sounds like the Jade Giant will cross a line he can't easily come back from.

item.title: THE FANTASTIC FOUR Composer Michael Giacchino Will Return To Score SPIDER-MAN: BRAND NEW DAY
item.description: Marvel Cinematic Universe veteran Michael Giacchino is set to make his return to the Spider-Man franchise, as he's confirmed to be scoring next summer's Spider-Man: Brand New Day.

item.title: Netflix Co-CEO Says Warner Bros.' Video Games Are Just A "Minor" Component Of The Larger Acquisition
item.description: It appears that WB Games may not hold much strategic value for Netflix when weighed against the broader goal of acquiring Warner Bros.’ film and television intellectual property.

item.title: SUPERGIRL Director Craig Gillespie Reveals He Read The Film’s Script Before Reading WOMAN OF TOMORROW Comic
item.description: Supergirl director Craig Gillespie revealed he wasn’t familiar with the character’s lore before helming the film, and stated he read the movie’s screenplay before reading the Woman of Tomorrow miniseries.

item.title: HOUSE OF THE DRAGON Matt Smith Reveals His "Daft Haircut" For Mystery STAR WARS: STARFIGHTER Role
item.description: Morbius star Matt Smith has confirmed that he's wrapped filming his mysterious—likely villainous—role in Star Wars: Starfighter, and heaps praise on Deadpool & Wolverine filmmaker Shawn Levy.

item.title: When Will The Four AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Trailers Be Released? Here's What We Know So Far
item.description: With four Avengers: Doomsday trailers on the way, we're taking a look at when the long-awaited sneak peeks are likely to be released in theaters alongside Avatar: Fire and Ash.

item.title: "Why No Alligators?" ZOOTOPIA 2 Co-Director Jared Bush Celebrates Box Office Success With Fan Q&A
item.description: Zootopia 2 director Jared Bush teases a possible Keanu Reeves cameo as a llama assassin, hints at exploring Nick Wilde’s past, and shares an update on the upcoming Encanto Animal Kingdom attraction.

item.title: Shipwrecked Warrior vs. Cannibals: LONE SAMURAI Is Now Slicing And Slashing On Digital
item.description: Set in the 13th century, Lone Samurai pits a highly skilled warrior against a ruthless tribe of cannibals, delivering a brutal, action-heavy clash.
